{{Top|leg}}
The '''Magl'Ikkan Temple''' was built at the base of a huge underwater mountain on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Baralou]]. The temple had been carved from carved and flattened sheets of [[treppok]] [[Bone/Legends|bone]] and filled with [[Coral/Legends|coral]] sculptures. It was located in the [[junieuw]] controlled by the [[Undrarian]]. The amphibious [[Krikthasi]] venerated the temple and rarely allowed other [[Species/Legends|species]] to come near it.<ref name="PoG1">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref>
